description.narrative: The development objective of the Competitiveness and Growth Project for Maldives is to strengthen private participation in and financial sustainability of state-owned enterprises (SOE), and the support mechanisms for the competitiveness of small and medium enterprises. The project comprises of three components. The first component, accelerating SOE reforms consist of following sub-components: (i) increasing private participation in ownership of select SOEs; (ii) improving governance of SOEs at the program and corporate level; and (iii) reforming SOE public service obligations. The second component, fostering small and medium enterprises (SME) competitiveness will enhance the competitiveness of Maldivian SMEs. It consists of following sub-components: (i) digital financial infrastructure; and (ii) SME growth acceleration program. The third component, project management will be established in the Ministry of Finance (MoF). The Project Management Unit (PMU) will be responsible for carrying out project activities and conducting monitoring and evaluation.

The project development objective is to strengthen private participation in and financial sustainability of State-Owned Enterprises, and the support mechanisms for the competitiveness of small and medium enterprises.

(FA, Schedule 2, Section IV): The Recipient shall:(a) ensure that the Project's activities involving collection, storage, usage,and/or processing of Personal Data are carried out with due regard to the Recipient's existing legal framework and appropriateinternational data protection and privacy standards and practices; (b) in the event that, during the implementation of theProject, the approval of any new legislation regarding Personal Data protection may have an impact on the activities financed bythe Project, ensure that a technical analysis of said impact is conducted, and that the necessary recommendations and adjustments,are implemented, as appropriate; and (c) except as may otherwise be explicitly required or permitted under this Agreement, or asmay be explicitly requested by the Association, in sharing any information, report or document related to the activities describedin Schedule 1 to this Agreement, ensure that such information, report or document does not include Personal Data.

title.narrative: Significant SOEs that establish clear public service obligations (PSO) reform plans

comment.narrative: 'Financial sustainability' for the project is defined as viability as relates to public service obligations (PSO). 'PSO' is defined as an obligation (that has financial consequences including capital contributions and/or subsidies) that the Government requires an SOE to undertake. PSO are used to pay for services provided by the SOE that are not compensated by the market. 'PSO reform plans' rfer to plans that include: (i) PSO definition and (ii) PSO targeting strategy. 'Significant SOEs' mean SOEs that have a balance sheet size and/or PSO size above an agreed threshold.

title.narrative: SOE private participation plans and due diligences completed and approved by the MoF

comment.narrative: Private participation plans and due diligences refer to any study completed on a SOE that includes a strategy for private participation or provides information (e.g., due diligence, regulatory advice, etc.) that assists a private participation process. For each planned SOE private participation, there will be one initial plan (total target = 4). This plan will, inter alia, develop a strategy, review the market conditions, and identify the due diligence requirements (usually 2-4 per transaction for a total target = 8). The sum total of plans and follow-on due diligences results in the target of 12.
